question: As of October 2024, which of the following is not recognized as a category under the Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yuva**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)** was launched on **8th April 2015** by Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** to provide financial support to small and micro businesses.
 
• Under PMMY, loans are categorized into three categories: **Shishu**, **Kishor**, and **Tarun**, based on the size and stage of the business.
 
• **Shishu:** Loans up to **₹50,000** for budding entrepreneurs aiming to start a small business.
 
• **Kishor:** Loans ranging from **₹50,001** to **₹5,00,000** for businesses looking to expand.
 
• **Tarun:** Loans ranging from **₹5,00,001** to **₹10,00,000** for well-established businesses seeking higher financial assistance.
 
• **Yuva** is not a recognized category under PMMY. The three categories focus on different stages of business development, but "Yuva" is not included in the official framework.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Objectives of PMMY:**

 
 
• To promote **entrepreneurship** among small and micro businesses in India.
 
• To provide **financial inclusion** to the unbanked segments of society.
 
• To create **employment opportunities** through the growth of small businesses.
 
 
 
• **Eligibility Criteria:**
 
 
• Any Indian citizen with a viable business plan in the **non-farm sector** can apply for a Mudra loan.
 
• The applicant must not have defaulted on any previous loans.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of PMMY:**
 
 
• Loans are offered without the need for **collateral**.
 
• The loans are provided through **commercial banks, regional rural banks, NBFCs, and microfinance institutions.**
 
• The scheme covers activities such as **manufacturing, trading, and services.**
 
 
 
• **Impact of PMMY:**
 
 
• PMMY has significantly contributed to the growth of **small and micro-enterprises**, especially in rural areas.
 
• It has helped bridge the gap in access to **formal credit** for entrepreneurs.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **MUDRA Bank:**

 
 
• The **Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency (MUDRA) Bank** was established to regulate and refinance microfinance institutions.
 
• MUDRA Bank plays a pivotal role in ensuring the success of PMMY by providing **financial assistance** to banks and NBFCs.
 
 
 
• **PMMY Statistics:**
 
 
• As of **2023**, PMMY has disbursed loans to over **30 crore beneficiaries**, with a majority being women entrepreneurs.
 
• It has contributed significantly to the **development of MSMEs** and created numerous job opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Focus on Women and SC/ST Entrepreneurs:**
 
 
• PMMY prioritizes loans for **women entrepreneurs** and individuals from **SC/ST** communities.
 
• This aligns with the government’s focus on **inclusive growth** and empowerment.
